sloka: ततः सङ्गाद्गता धेनुः सवत्सा स्पर्शिता ऽनघ ।ब्राह्मणस्याहिताग्नेश्च दरिद्रस्योञ्छवर्तिनः ।। ७.५३.९ ॥
transliteration: tataḥ saṅgādgatā dhenuḥ savatsā sparśitā 'nagha ।brāhmaṇasyāhitāgneśca daridrasyoñchavartinaḥ ।। 7.53.9 ॥

translations.english: O sinless one, then that cow with its calf, having come into contact, was taken by a poor Brahmana who maintained sacred fires and lived by gleaning.
